desc.zh: 构造递减回文候选，用较大因子的平方界限证明安全截止。
desc.en: Construct descending palindromes and derive a safe square cutoff for larger factors.

complexity: O(10^(2n) + n·10^n) time under unit-cost integer arithmetic; O(n) auxiliary space

concepts.name: Descending palindrome candidates
concepts.description: Mirror prefixes and scan lengths in descending order.

concepts.name: Larger-factor square cutoff
concepts.description: Test all possible larger factors and stop when x² < p.
